- large_get keeps the framing at both caps: the bulk header "$200000\r\n" is at offset 0 of the GET reply record and the payload is skipped by length (server: one 200011-byte record; client: 13 records). The SET request header "*3\r\n$3\r\nSET\r\n$7\r\nedc-big\r\n$200000\r\n" is in the first 1024 bytes of its record on both sides.
   Full per-direction tables: see "Per-scenario analysis".
5. MONITOR line shape: a simple string "+<unix seconds>.<6-digit microseconds> [<db> <client ip>:<client port>] \"<CMD>\" \"<arg>\" ...\r\n", one write per line on the server (56-61 bytes here); the monitor client read 4 lines in one 237-byte read. AUTH from the other client appears as "\"AUTH\" \"(redacted)\"" for both the good and the wrong password; SET and GET show key and value in clear. RESET on the monitor connection answers +RESET (no monitor line for RESET or MONITOR itself), and RESET also de-authenticates: the next PING got -NOAUTH, then AUTH and PING worked.
6. DEBUG PROTOCOL worked (--enable-debug-command local, client on 127.0.0.1) for string, integer, double (",3.141"), bignum ("(1234567999999999999999999999999999999"), null ("_"), array, set ("~3"), map ("%3"), attrib, verbatim ("=29\r\ntxt:This is a verbatim\nstring\r\n"), true ("#t"), false ("#f") and push. attrib is one 93-byte write: "|1" attribute (key-popularity -> *2 [key:123, :90]) followed by the real reply "$39 Some real reply following the attribute". push is one 79-byte write: ">2 [server-cpu-usage, :42]" followed by "$40 Some real reply following the push reply". So an attribute and a push can share a record with the reply that follows.
7. RESP3: HELLO 3 answers "%7" (server, version, proto, id, mode, role, modules). HGETALL answers "%2", SMEMBERS "~3", ZSCORE ",1.5", GET of a missing key "_". CLIENT TRACKING ON then GET edc-tk, then SET edc-tk from the other connection: the client gets ">2 [invalidate, *1 [edc-tk]]" as its own 37-byte record with no command pending. SUBSCRIBE in RESP3 answers with a push ">3 [subscribe, edc-r3, :1]", the published message arrives as ">3 [message, edc-r3, m3]", PING while subscribed answers a plain "+PONG" (not an array), UNSUBSCRIBE answers ">3 [unsubscribe, edc-r3, :0]".
8. RESP2 pub/sub: SUBSCRIBE edc-ch1 edc-ch2 answers two "*3 [subscribe, <ch>, :n]" arrays in one write; PSUBSCRIBE answers "*3 [psubscribe, edc-ch*, :3]"; a PUBLISH to edc-ch1 delivers "*3 [message, edc-ch1, hello-1]" and "*4 [pmessage, edc-ch*, edc-ch1, hello-1]" in one write; PING while subscribed answers "*2 [pong, \"\"]" and PING edc-ping-arg answers "*2 [pong, edc-ping-arg]"; UNSUBSCRIBE without arguments answers two "*3 [unsubscribe, <ch>, :n]" (counts 2 and 1, the pattern still counts) in one write; PUNSUBSCRIBE answers "*3 [punsubscribe, edc-ch*, :0]"; the next PING answers "+PONG".
9. redis-cli reading commands from stdin (secrets, errors) first sends "COMMAND DOCS" and then "COMMAND" by itself. Without a password both answer -NOAUTH. With -a the COMMAND DOCS reply is a 480-element map array of about 172 KB in several writes, and its framing is lost at cap 1024 (seen in a trial run; that is why large_get uses redis-cli with the command on the command line, which sends only AUTH and the command).
10. MULTI/EXEC: MULTI +OK, each queued command +QUEUED, EXEC with SET and INCR on a non-integer value answers "*2 [+OK, -ERR value is not an integer or out of range]"; DISCARD +OK; WATCH edc-wk, SET edc-wk from the other connection, MULTI, SET, EXEC answers "*-1" (RESP2 null array); an unknown command inside MULTI answers "-ERR unknown command 'NOSUCHCMD', with args beginning with: 'edc-arg' ", the next command still answers +QUEUED, and EXEC answers "-EXECABORT Transaction discarded because of previous errors."; MULTI, INCR, INCR, EXEC in one write answer "+OK +QUEUED +QUEUED *2 [:1, :2]" in one write.
11. Error replies seen: NOAUTH, WRONGPASS, WRONGTYPE, ERR (unknown command, echoes up to the first arguments in quotes), NOSCRIPT, EXECABORT, IOERR. The unknown-command error echoes the argument text ("'edc-arg'"), so error messages can carry argument bytes.
12. Secrets in replies: CONFIG GET requirepass answers the password in clear (RESP3 map "%1 requirepass edc-fixture-pass"), CONFIG GET masterauth answers edc-secret-master in clear. ACL GETUSER and ACL LIST answer the SHA-256 of the ACL password ("#6fcd8525..." for edc-secret-acl, "#b989444c..." for edc-fixture-pass), not the password. The HELLO 3 AUTH reply carries no password.
13. Inline: Redis accepts "PING\n" (LF only) as well as CRLF lines; replies are normal RESP. Two inline lines in one write are answered in one write.

		flow.state, flow.left = httpResponseLength, flow.length
	default:
		// 길이를 알 수 없는 응답(HTTP/1.0)은 연결이 닫혀야 끝난다. 닫힌 시각은 완료 시각이 아니라서 응답 없이 둔다.
		call.responseLost()
		return false
	}
	return true
}

func parseHTTPRecord(sample []byte) (httpPacket, bool) {
	if len(sample) < httpRecordPayloadOffset || binary.LittleEndian.Uint32(sample[8:12]) != httpRecordType {
		return httpPacket{}, false
	}
	family := binary.LittleEndian.Uint16(sample[36:38])
	var source, destination [16]byte
	copy(source[:], sample[44:60])
	copy(destination[:], sample[60:76])
	packet := httpPacket{
		bootTimeNS:   binary.LittleEndian.Uint64(sample[0:8]),
		pid:          binary.LittleEndian.Uint32(sample[12:16]),
		cgroupID:     binary.LittleEndian.Uint64(sample[16:24]),
		socket:       binary.LittleEndian.Uint64(sample[24:32]),
		sent:         sample[38]&httpRecordSent != 0,
		decrypted:    sample[38]&httpRecordDecrypted != 0,
		source:       formatCaptureAddress(family, source, binary.LittleEndian.Uint16(sample[40:42])),
		destination:  formatCaptureAddress(family, destination, binary.LittleEndian.Uint16(sample[42:44])),
		process:      strings.TrimRight(string(sample[76:92]), "\x00"),
		payload:      sample[httpRecordPayloadOffset:],
		continued:    sample[39] == httpRecordContinuation,
		tlsHandshake: sample[39] == httpRecordTLSHandshake,
		offset:       binary.LittleEndian.Uint32(sample[92:96]),
	}
	if size := int(binary.LittleEndian.Uint32(sample[32:36])); size < len(packet.payload) {
		packet.payload = packet.payload[:size]
	}
	return packet, true
}

func (model traceScreenModel) updateDetailKey(key string) (traceScreenModel, tea.Cmd) {
	page := traceScreenDetailPage(model)
	var cmd tea.Cmd
	switch key {
	case "esc", "enter", "q", "backspace":
		model.detail, model.follow = nil, false
		model.detailGeneration++
		model.detailJobPending = nil
	case "f":
		// 따라가기를 끄면 보던 event에서 멈추고, 목록으로 돌아가도 그 event를 고른 채로 둔다.
		if model.follow {
			model.follow, model.selected = false, model.detail.number
			model.detailGeneration++
			model.detailJobPending = nil
		} else {
			cmd = model.openFollow()
		}
	case "m":
		model.secrets = !model.secrets
		model.detailGeneration++
		offset := model.detail.offset

		model.detail = model.detailShell(model.detail.number, "preparing detail…")
		model.detail.preserveOffset = preserveOffset
		model.detail.restoreOffset = offset
		cmd = model.requestDetailBuild()
	case "z":
		model.decode = !model.decode
		model.detailGeneration++
		offset := model.detail.offset
		preserveOffset := len(model.detail.raw) > 1 && !model.detail.updating
		model.detail = model.detailShell(model.detail.number, "preparing detail…")

func (model historyOverviewBrowser) atTop() bool { return true }
func (model historyOverviewBrowser) Init() tea.Cmd { return nil }

func (model historyOverviewBrowser) Update(msg tea.Msg) (tea.Model, tea.Cmd) {
	switch value := msg.(type) {
	case tea.WindowSizeMsg:
		model.width, model.height = value.Width, value.Height
	case tea.KeyPressMsg:
		switch value.String() {
		case "q", "ctrl+c":
			return model, tea.Quit
		case "esc":
			if !model.hosted {
				return model, tea.Quit
			}
		case "r":
			model.overview, model.err = loadHistoryOverview(model.db, model.options)
			model.offset = 0
		case "up", "k":
			model.offset = max(0, model.offset-1)
		case "down", "j":
			model.offset++
		case "pgup":
			model.offset = max(0, model.offset-max(1, model.height-4))
		case "pgdown":
			model.offset += max(1, model.height-4)
		case "home":
			model.offset = 0
		case "end":
			model.offset = model.maxOffset()
		}
		model.offset = min(model.offset, model.maxOffset())
	}
	return model, nil
}

func (model historyOverviewBrowser) View() tea.View {
	width := max(1, model.width)
	lines := model.lines()
	footer := model.footer(width)
	room := max(1, model.height-len(footer))
	model.offset = min(model.offset, model.maxOffset())
	body := lines[model.offset:min(len(lines), model.offset+room)]
	body = append(body, footer...)
	for index := range body {
		body[index] = ansi.Truncate(body[index], width, "…")
	}
	view := tea.NewView(strings.Join(body, "\n"))
	view.AltScreen = true
	return view
}

func runTunnel(args []string, version string) int {
	subcommand := ""
	if len(args) > 0 && !strings.HasPrefix(args[0], "-") {
		subcommand, args = args[0], args[1:]
	}
	options := configuredCommon(30 * time.Second)
	connectTimeout := 10 * time.Second
	var filePath, name, local, reverse, socks string
	var all, save bool
	set := newFlagSet("tunnel")
	set.SetOutput(os.Stderr)
	bindCommon(set, &options)
	set.StringVar(&filePath, "file", "", T("command.tunnel.option.file"))
	set.StringVar(&name, "name", "", T("command.tunnel.option.name"))
	set.StringVar(&local, "L", "", T("command.tunnel.option.local"))
	set.StringVar(&reverse, "R", "", T("command.tunnel.option.reverse"))
	set.StringVar(&socks, "D", "", T("command.tunnel.option.socks"))
	set.BoolVar(&all, "all", false, T("command.tunnel.option.all"))
	set.BoolVar(&save, "save", false, T("command.tunnel.option.save"))
	set.DurationVar(&connectTimeout, "connect-timeout", connectTimeout, T("command.tunnel.option.connect_timeout"))
	if err := parseReordered(set, args); err != nil {
		return 2
	}
	if options.timeout <= 0 || connectTimeout <= 0 {
		fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, tunnelError("tunnel.error.timeout_range"))
		return 2
	}
	if save && subcommand != "up" {
		fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, tunnelError("tunnel.error.save_up_only"))
		return 2
	}
	environment, err := newTunnelEnvironment(filePath, connectTimeout, save && subcommand == "up")

return positional[0], spec, true
}

func TestFSWatchClassifyHandlesAccumulatedFlags(t *testing.T) {
	started := time.Unix(1000, 0)
	before, after := started.Add(-time.Second), started.Add(time.Second)
	file := fsWatchPathState{exists: true, inode: 7, size: 1, mtime: after, birth: after}
	grown := file
	grown.size, grown.mtime = 2, after.Add(time.Second)
	old := fsWatchPathState{exists: true, inode: 7, size: 1, mtime: before, birth: before}
	gone := fsWatchPathState{}
	const (
		created  = fsevents.FlagItemCreated
		modified = fsevents.FlagItemModified
		removed  = fsevents.FlagItemRemoved
		renamed  = fsevents.FlagItemRenamed
	)
	for _, test := range []struct {
		name     string
		flags    uint32
		previous fsWatchPathState
		known    bool
		current  fsWatchPathState
		want     []string
	}{
		{"new file", created | modified, gone, false, file, []string{"create"}},
		{"write after create keeps the created flag", created | modified, file, true, grown, []string{"modify"}},
		{"repeat with no change", created | modified, file, true, file, nil},
		{"file from before the watch", created, gone, false, old, nil},
		{"old file written before the watch", modified, gone, false, old, nil},
		{"old file written now", modified, gone, false, grown, []string{"modify"}},
		{"renamed in", renamed, gone, false, file, []string{"create"}},
		{"old file renamed in", renamed, gone, false, old, []string{"create"}},
		{"renamed away after create", created | modified | renamed, file, true, gone, []string{"rename"}},
		{"removed after rename in", renamed | removed, file, true, gone, []string{"remove"}},
